verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਈ ਬਾਹਲੇ ਰੰਗ ਜਿਉ ਖੜੁ ਚਰਿ ਦੁਧੁ ਦੇਨਿ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: gaiee baahale ra(n)g jiau khaR char dhudh dhen ik ra(n)gee|

en.bdb: Though the cows are of different hues yet their milk is of the same (white) colour.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਲੇ ਬਿਰਖ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ ਅਗਨੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: baahale birakh vanaasapat aganee a(n)dhar hai bahu ra(n)gee|

en.bdb: The vegetation has variety of trees but is the fire therein of different colours?

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਰਤਨ ਪਾਰਖੂ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਸੰਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: ratanaa vekhai sabh ko ratan paarakhoo viralaa sa(n)gee|

en.bdb: Many behold the jewels but the jeweler is a rare person.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੀਰੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਰਤਨ ਮਾਲ ਸਤਿਸੰਗਤਿ ਚੰਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: heere heeraa bedhiaa ratan maal satisa(n)gat cha(n)gee|

en.bdb: As the diamond interlaced with other diamonds goes in the company of jewels, likewise the mind-diamond intertwined with the diamond like Guru Word goes in the string of the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਓਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਰਸੁ ਮੰਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)mrit nadhar nihaalion hoi nihaal na horas ma(n)gee|

en.bdb: Knowledgeable people get blessed with the ambrosial sight of the Guru and then have no desire whatsoever.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਿਬ ਦੇਹ ਦਿਬ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਹੋਇ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: dhib dheh dhib dhisaT hoi pooran braham jot a(n)g a(n)gee|

en.bdb: Their body and vision turns divine and their every limb reflects the divine light of the perfect Brahm.
Their relations with the true Guru are established through the holy congregation.
